items.title: Project Hail Mary
items.reason: A lone scientist reconstructs his mission and uses experimental science to investigate a mysterious organism threatening the Sun, with escalating biological and extraterrestrial discoveries rather than action-first spectacle.

items.title: Signal One
items.reason: A computer scientist joins an isolated project built to communicate with alien intelligence, keeping experimental technology, scientific ethics and the need to understand an unknown signal at the center.

items.title: Anti Matter
items.reason: An Oxford scientist's wormhole experiment leaves her unable to form new memories, turning the film into a direct investigation of what the experiment changed and what its impossible result means.

items.title: Extracted
items.reason: A scientist enters a murder suspect's memories using experimental technology and becomes trapped inside the system, making the central problem a scientific mind/memory puzzle that must be understood from within.
aliases: Memory Effect - Verloren in einer anderen Dimension

items.title: The A-Frame
items.reason: A quantum physicist's subatomic-portal experiment unexpectedly produces a cancer treatment, giving the premise a strong science-experiment and biological-consequence core despite its horror framing.

items.title: Orphan Black
items.reason: Cloning, tagged DNA, experimental programs and layered conspiracies continuously expand the central biological mystery, making it one of the closest available matches to the science-and-conspiracy side of Fringe.

items.title: The Swarm
items.reason: A global group of scientists investigates escalating ecological anomalies, unusual organisms and a previously unknown marine intelligence, strongly matching the biology/ecology/phenomenon profile.

items.title: Dark Matter
items.reason: A physicist is thrown into an alternate version of his life and must learn the rules of a technology-driven multiverse; the series repeatedly turns suspense into discovery about the Box and its realities.
